name: space force

events.event: US Space Force confirmed on Monday that the US has deployed weapons into orbit.
US Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink announced on Monday that the US now had 'on-orbit space control weapons' capable of defending American forces against hostile action.
US Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink said revealing more about the capability would undermine its deterrent value.
